caseTitle: Juana Dela Cruz - Annual Income Tax Return Filing
caseSummary: Client seeks assistance in filing an annual income tax return. Employment and business records require verification.
potentialIssues: Bank deposits exceed reported sales by ₱50,000.
One sales invoice was not included in declared revenue.
Business income was initially omitted from the case summary.

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Npc
receptionistGreeting.text: Good morning! Welcome to the tax office.

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Npc
receptionistGreeting.text: I have a client case ready for you. Please review the documents carefully before making your assessment.

receptionistGreeting.speaker: Player
receptionistGreeting.text: Understood. I'll review the client's records and determine what needs to be addressed.

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Npc
clientFirstMeeting.text: Hello. I'm here because I need help preparing my annual income tax return.

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Player
clientFirstMeeting.text: I'll review your employment and business records first so we can determine the correct tax treatment.

clientFirstMeeting.speaker: Npc
clientFirstMeeting.text: Sure. I brought the documents I have with me.

interviewLines.speaker: Player
interviewLines.text: I see that you have both employment and business income. Can you confirm that you had one employer during the tax year?

interviewLines.speaker: Npc
interviewLines.text: Yes. I worked for ABC Corporation while also operating JD Online Services.

interviewLines.speaker: Player
interviewLines.text: Your records also indicate that the business is registered. Did you choose the eight percent income tax option?

interviewLines.speaker: Npc
interviewLines.text: Yes, I registered the business and selected the eight percent tax rate.

interviewLines.speaker: Player
interviewLines.text: Thank you. I'll compare your declarations against the supporting records before making the final assessment.

outcomeCorrectNoIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectNoIssues.text: After reviewing the records, the assessment is correct and there are no unresolved issues.

outcomeCorrectNoIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectNoIssues.text: That's good to hear. Thank you for checking everything carefully.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: Your tax classification is correct, but I found issues that need to be addressed before the return can be filed.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: What kind of issues did you find?

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: The bank records show deposits that are not fully reflected in the reported sales, so the records need further verification.

outcomeCorrectWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeCorrectWithIssues.text: I understand. I'll provide whatever additional records are needed.

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: The assessment does not match the information found in the case records.

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: I thought the information I provided was enough. What did I miss?

outcomeWrongVerdict.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdict.text: Some of the taxpayer classification and income information needs to be reviewed before a final filing decision can be made.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: The assessment is incorrect, and the supporting records also contain unresolved discrepancies.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: So the return cannot be filed yet?

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Player
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: Correct. The taxpayer classification must be corrected and the discrepancies between the reported income and supporting documents must be investigated.

outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.speaker: Npc
outcomeWrongVerdictWithIssues.text: I'll work on getting the missing information and correcting the records.
